# Correlation of Irrigation Flow and Trait

```{r}
#| label: irrigation-trait-correlation

load("./data/MeansTable.RData")
library(ggplot2)

traits <- read.csv("traitsGLMMres.csv", header = TRUE, encoding = "UTF-8")
colors <- c("yellow", "skyblue", "red", "lightgreen", "hotpink", "purple1")  # Distinct colors

df <- df_tot

plots <- list()
for (i in 1:nrow(traits)) {

  plots[[i]] <- ggplot(
    df,
    aes_string(x = paste0("value_", traits$abrv[i]), y = "irr_flw")
  ) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = generation), shape = 23, alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +
  geom_smooth(method = "glm", se = TRUE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors, name = "Gen") +
  labs(
       x = latex2exp::TeX(traits$name[i]),
       y = latex2exp::TeX("Irrigation Flow ($mm.h^{-1}$)")
       ) +
  ggpubr::stat_cor(aes(label = ..rr.label..),
                   label.x.npc = "left",
                   label.y.npc = "top",
                   digits = 3) +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

  plot(plots[[i]])
}

# postscript("figures/irrcv.eps")
# do.call(grid.arrange, c(plots, ncol = 5, nrow = 3))
# dev.off()
detach("package:ggplot2", unload = TRUE)
```


# Box-Cox of trait data

```{r}
#| label: boxcox-traits

load("./data/MeansTable.RData")

traits <- read.csv("traitsGLMMres.csv", header = TRUE, encoding = "UTF-8")
# pdf("figures/boxcox.pdf", width=12, height=8)

# set a 3‑row by 5‑column grid for base‑R plots
def_par <- par(mfrow = c(3, 5), mar = c(4, 4, 2, 1))
on.exit(par(def_par))

for (i in 1:nrow(traits)) {
  # pull out the vector, add a tiny constant
  x <- na.omit(df_tot[[paste0("value_", traits$abrv[i])]]) + 1e-4
  
  # draw the base‑R Box–Cox plot
  MASS::boxcox(
    sqrt(x^2) ~ 1,
    data  = data.frame(x = x),
    xlab  = latex2exp::TeX(paste0("Lambda \\lambda ", traits$name[i]))
  )
}

# dev.off()
```

# Boxlot of Means and Std Errors

```{r}
#| label: boxplot-means

load("./data/MeansTable.RData")
library(tidyverse)

traits <- read.csv("traitsGLMMres.csv", header = TRUE, encoding = "UTF-8")
colors <- c("yellow", "skyblue", "red", "lightgreen", "hotpink", "purple1")

plots <- list()
for (i in 1:nrow(traits)){

	vsr <- c("value", "solution", "res")
	old <- paste(vsr, traits$abrv[i], sep = "_")

	# Perform two left joins and coalesce the results
	df <- df_tot |>
		select(c(names(df_names), all_of(old))) |> 
		rename_with(~ vsr, all_of(old)) |>
		mutate(solution = if_else(
					  generation %in% c("P1", "P2", "F1"),
					  solution + res,
					  solution)) |>
		pivot_longer(c(value, solution)) |> 
		mutate(name = factor(name,
				     levels = c("value", "solution"),
				     labels = c("Raw", "BLUEs")))

	# Basic box plot
	plots[[i]] <- ggplot(df, aes(x = generation, y = value,
			    fill = generation, color = name), 
		    na.rm = TRUE) +
		geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.6, position = position_dodge(0.9)) +
		scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
		scale_color_manual(values = c("black", "darkgrey")) +
		labs(
		     title = latex2exp::TeX(traits$name[i]),
		     color = "Dataset",
		     fill = "Generation",
		     x = NULL,
		     y = NULL
		     # y = latex2exp::TeX(traits$name[i])
		     ) +
		# theme_minimal() +
		scale_x_discrete(limits=c("BC2","BC1","F2","F1","P2","P1")) +
		theme(
		      axis.text.y = element_blank(),  # Remove x-axis tick labels
		      axis.ticks.y = element_blank()  # Remove x-axis ticks
		      ) +
		coord_flip() 

  plot(plots[[i]])
}

# postscript(paste0("figures/variances_tot.eps"))
# do.call(grid.arrange, c(plots, ncol = 5, nrow = 3))
# dev.off()
detach("package:tidyverse", unload = TRUE)
```

```{r}
#| label: histograms-by-generation

load("./data/MeansTable.RData")
library(ggplot2)

# Iterate over each trait to create histograms with normal distribution curves
traits <- read.csv("traitsGLMMres.csv", header = TRUE, encoding = "UTF-8")

plots <- list()
for (i in 1:nrow(traits)) {
	name <- traits$name[i]  # Descriptive name for the current trait

	# Create the plot
	plots[[i]] <- ggplot(df_tot, aes_string(x = paste0("value_", traits$abrv[i]))) +
		geom_histogram(aes(y = ..density..),
			       binwidth = 1, 
			       fill = "lightgray", 
			       color = "white", 
			       na.rm = TRUE) +
		geom_density(aes(y = ..density..),
			     color = "blue",
			     lwd = 1,
			     na.rm = TRUE) +
		facet_wrap(~generation, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
		labs(
		     title = paste("Distribution of", name, "by Generation"),
		     x = name,
		     y = "Density"
		     ) +
		theme_minimal() +
		theme(legend.position = "top")

	# Display the plot
	plot(plots[[i]])
}

detach("package:ggplot2", unload = TRUE)
```

```{r}
#| label: normal-fit-by-generation

load("./data/MeansTable.RData")

df <- df_tot

traits <- read.csv("traitsGLMMres.csv", header = TRUE, encoding = "UTF-8")
colors <- c("yellow", "skyblue", "red", "lightgreen", "hotpink", "purple1")

def_par <- par(mfrow = c(3, 5), mar = c(4, 4, 2, 1))
on.exit(par(def_par))

for (i in 1:nrow(traits)){
  abrv <- paste0("value_", traits$abrv[i])

	# Calculate densities and find max density for ylim adjustment
	densities <- lapply(split(df[[abrv]], df$generation), density, na.rm = TRUE)
	max_density <- max(sapply(densities, function(d) max(d$y)))

	# Create an empty histogram with adjusted ylim

	hist(df[[abrv]], 
	     # main = paste0("Normal fit of ", tolower(traits$name[i]), " by generation"), 
	     # xlab = traits$name[i], 
	     main = "",
	     xlab = "",
	     ylab = "Density", 
	     freq = FALSE,             # Plot density instead of counts
	     col = "lightgray",        # Light background for clarity
	     border = "white",         # Remove bar borders
	     ylim = c(0, max_density + 0.025))  # Set ylim based on max density

	# Add legend
	# legend("topright", legend = levels(df$generation), col = colors, lwd = 2, title = "Generation")

	# Add normal distribution fit lines
	mean_val <- mean(df[[abrv]], na.rm = TRUE)    # Mean of the group
	sd_val <- sd(df[[abrv]], na.rm = TRUE)        # Standard deviation of the group

	curve(dnorm(x, mean = mean_val, sd = sd_val),  # Normal curve
	      lwd = 2, add = TRUE)

	for (j in unique(df$generation)) {
		group_data <- df[[abrv]][df$generation == j]
		mean_val <- mean(group_data, na.rm = TRUE)    # Mean of the group
		sd_val <- sd(group_data, na.rm = TRUE)        # Standard deviation of the group

		curve(dnorm(x, mean = mean_val, sd = sd_val),  # Normal curve
		      col = colors[which(unique(df$generation) == j)],
		      lwd = 2, add = TRUE)
	}

	# Add legend
	legend("topright", legend = levels(as.factor(df$generation)), col = colors, lwd = 2, title = "Generation")
}
```

#GMA A+D models

```{r}
#| label: gma-ad-setup

load("./data/MeansTable.RData")
library(tidyverse)

traits <- read.csv(
  "traitsGLMMres.csv",
  header = TRUE,
  encoding = "UTF-8"
)

traitsEPI <- traits |> filter(trait %in% c(
  "num_sideshoot",
  "total_leaf_sideshoot",
  "sideshoot_length"
))

traitsAD <- setdiff(traits, traitsEPI)

gma <- list_rbind(gma_list) |>
  filter(model != "epi", abrv %in% traitsAD$abrv) |> 
  select(abrv, Dataset, parameters, estimates) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = parameters, values_from = estimates) |>
  mutate(
    abrv = fct_drop(abrv),
    Dataset = fct_recode(Dataset, Raw = "rawvar", BLUEs = "predvar"),
    AA = mhat - ahat,
    BB = mhat + ahat,
    AB = mhat + dhat,
    pdom = round(abs(dhat / ahat), 3),
    gene_action = factor(
      case_when(
        pdom < 0.15  ~ "additive",
        pdom < 0.80  ~ "partial",
        pdom < 1.25  ~ "complete",
        pdom >= 1.25 ~ "over"
      ),
      levels = c("additive", "partial", "complete", "over")
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(abrv) |>
  mutate(
    delta = 0.03 * (max(c(AA, BB, AB)) - min(c(AA, BB, AB))),
    x     = min(c(AA, BB, AB)) - delta,
    xend  = max(c(AA, BB, AB)) + delta
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(abrv, dataset = Dataset, gene_action, AA, BB, AB, µ = mhat, x, xend) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(AA, BB, AB, µ),
    names_to = "param",
    values_to = "genval"
  ) |>
  glimpse()

seg_df <- gma |>
  distinct(abrv, gene_action, x, xend)

dataset_cols <- c(Raw = "#2c7fb8", BLUEs = "#d95f02")

p <- ggplot(gma, aes(y = abrv)) +
  geom_segment(
    data = seg_df,
    aes(x = x, xend = xend, y = abrv, yend = abrv),
    arrow = arrow(angle = 90, ends = "both", length = unit(5, "pt")),
    linewidth = 0.5,
    colour = "gray30"
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(x = genval, colour = dataset),
    shape = 124,        # vertical bar glyph; reads as a tick mark on the ruler
    size = 4
  ) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data = filter(gma, dataset == "Raw"),
    aes(x = genval, label = param, colour = dataset),
    nudge_y = -0.28, direction = "x",
    size = 3, segment.size = 0.2, segment.color = "gray70",
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data = filter(gma, dataset == "BLUEs"),
    aes(x = genval, label = param, colour = dataset),
    nudge_y = 0.28, direction = "x",
    size = 3, segment.size = 0.2, segment.color = "gray70",
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ gene_action, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = dataset_cols, name = NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0.08)) +
  labs(x = "Genotypic value", y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    legend.position    = "top",
    legend.justification = "left",
    legend.key.width   = unit(22, "pt"),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "gray92"),
    strip.text         = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0),
    strip.background   = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y       = element_blank(),
    plot.margin        = margin(8, 12, 8, 8)
  )

ggsave("./figures/ruler_combined.svg", p,
       width = 7, height = 9, device = svglite::svglite)

library(ggh4x)   # facet_nested_wrap + strip_themed

gma_plot <- gma |>
  filter(param %in% c("AA", "AB", "BB")) |>
  mutate(
    param   = factor(param, levels = c("AA", "AB", "BB")),
    dataset = factor(dataset, levels = c("Raw", "BLUEs")),
    gene_action = factor(
      gene_action,
      levels = c("additive", "partial", "complete", "over"),
      labels = c("Absence of dominance", "Partial dominance",
                 "Complete dominance",   "Overdominance")
    )
  )

genotype_cols  <- c(AA = "#b8442b", AB = "#d4a13a", BB = "#2e6f8e")
gene_action_bg <- c("#e8e2cc", "#d6e2c8", "#d0d4e0", "#e6d0d0")
n_traits <- n_distinct(gma_plot$abrv)

p <- ggplot(gma_plot, aes(x = dataset, y = genval, group = param)) +
  geom_line(linetype = "dashed", colour = "gray70", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_point(
    data = ~ filter(.x, dataset == "Raw"),
    aes(colour = param),
    shape = 16, size = 2.8
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = ~ filter(.x, dataset == "BLUEs"),
    aes(colour = param),
    shape = 5, size = 2.8, stroke = 0.9
  ) +
  ggh4x::facet_nested_wrap(
    vars(gene_action, abrv),
    scales = "free_y",
    nrow   = 2,
    strip  = strip_themed(
      background_x = elem_list_rect(
        fill = c(gene_action_bg, rep("white", n_traits)),
        colour = c(rep("gray70", 4), rep("gray85", n_traits))
      ),
      text_x = elem_list_text(
        face = c(rep("bold", 4), rep("plain", n_traits)),
        size = c(rep(10, 4),     rep(9,  n_traits))
      )
    )
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = genotype_cols, name = NULL) +
  scale_x_discrete(position = "top", expand = expansion(add = 0.45)) +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 16, size = 3))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    legend.position      = "top",
    legend.justification = "left",
    panel.spacing.x      = unit(6,  "pt"),
    panel.spacing.y      = unit(10, "pt"),
    panel.grid.minor     = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x   = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y   = element_line(colour = "gray92"),
    panel.border         = element_rect(fill = NA, colour = "gray85"),
    strip.text           = element_text(margin = margin(3, 4, 3, 4)),
    axis.text.x          = element_text(size = 8, colour = "gray45"),
    axis.ticks.y         = element_line(colour = "gray80")
  )

ggsave("./figures/ruler_designE.svg", p,
       width = 12, height = 8, device = svglite::svglite)

for (i in levels(gma$abrv)){

  trt_df <- gma[gma$abrv == i, ]

  plots <- ggplot() +
    geom_segment(
      data = trt_df,
      aes(x = x, xend = xend, y = 0, yend = 0),
      arrow = arrow(angle = 90, end = "both", length = unit(8, "pt")),
      linewidth = 1
    ) + 
    geom_point(
      data = trt_df,
      aes(x = genval, y = 0, color = dataset),
      shape = "-",
      size = 5
    ) +
    # ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    geom_text(
      data = trt_df[trt_df$dataset == "Raw",],
      aes(x = genval, y = -1, label = param),
      size = 4,
      check_overlap = TRUE
    ) +
    # ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    geom_text(
      data = trt_df[trt_df$dataset == "BLUEs",],
      aes(x = genval, y = +1, label = param),
      size = 4,
      check_overlap = TRUE
    ) +
    ylim(-4, 4) +
    coord_flip() 
    # theme_minimal() +
    # theme(
    #   axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    #   axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    #   axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    #   axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11),
    #   axis.ticks.y = element_line(color = "gray80"),
    #   panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "gray90"),
    #   panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    #   plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
    # )
    
  svglite::svglite(
    paste0("./figures/ruler2_", i, ".svg"),
    width = 3,
    height = 5
  )
  plot(plots) 
  dev.off()

}
```
